articles.title: Mr Showbiz, the Forgotten Crooner of Calcutta’s Park Street
articles.summary: For three decades, Vivian Hansen sang at Calcutta’s most storied venues, from Trincas and Magnolia to Mocambo. Now 86 and retired in South London, he remembers the musicians, crowds, and late nights that defined a vanished era on Park Street. All Photos: Courtesy of Vivian Hansen
